input: I need a few more physical cards.
reference_answer: You can hold at most 2 physical cards. A spare costs £5; order it under Cards, Add card, Spare physical card.

input: How long does it take for an international transfer into my account?
reference_answer: An international (SWIFT) transfer into the account takes 3 to 5 working days.

input: Need help with my card. It's not working.
reference_answer: Check the card is activated, not frozen or expired, the balance covers the payment, the payment type is switched on and the daily limit is not reached; try chip and PIN elsewhere, then contact support.

input: I finally got my new card and was very excited to use it today. However, my payment kept declining. What is happening?
reference_answer: Open the declined payment to see the reason. Common causes include low balance, wrong PIN or details, a frozen or blocked card, the daily limit, security checks or the merchant. Contact support if no reason is shown or it happens again.

input: I've attempted to do a very standard transfer and have tried 5 times at this point. Can you tell me what the issue is? Is the system down?
reference_answer: Check the reason in the app. Causes include not enough money, wrong recipient details, rejection by the receiving bank, security checks, unfinished identity or source of funds checks, or a recipient that is not allowed. Correct it and retry; contact support if no reason is shown.

input: The balance on my account wasn't updated after I made a depost.
reference_answer: Cash deposits usually appear within 30 minutes and can take 1 working day. Check the receipt; if still missing after that, contact support with a photo of the receipt, the shop and the time.

input: Is there currency exchange on this app?
reference_answer: Yes. Open Exchange, pick the two currencies, enter an amount, check the rate and fee, and confirm.

input: I tried to take out cash but the amount isn't right, so what do I do?
reference_answer: Count the cash, keep the receipt, note time, place and operator, and contact support with the amount requested and received; a dispute is opened.

input: Why is the exchange rate wrong for my international withdrawal?
reference_answer: The NovaPay rate at authorisation is used unless the cash machine converted it, which is often worse. Check the rate and fees, the weekend markup and free withdrawal allowance; if it still does not match, contact support with the receipt.

input: Where am I able to use the card?
reference_answer: At merchants that accept the card's network, in the UK and abroad. Some unattended machines, car hire firms and shops that do not take debit cards may refuse it.

input: How do I change my PIN?
reference_answer: In the app open Cards, select the card, choose PIN then Change PIN, enter the new PIN twice, and insert the card for the next payment.

input: Explain what the pending payment means?
reference_answer: The merchant has reserved the money but not collected it yet. Most pending payments complete or are released within 7 days; hotels and car hire up to 30 days.

input: Why was I overcharged a pound!?
reference_answer: Open the charge to see its type. It may be a temporary verification charge, a merchant hold, a cash withdrawal fee, an exchange fee or a merchant subscription. If you do not recognise it, freeze the card and contact support.

input: When would my card be charged an extra fee for a transaction?
reference_answer: NovaPay does not charge for card payments in a currency you hold enough of. If conversion is needed the exchange rules apply, and some merchants add their own surcharge.

input: How can I fund my top-up account using my bank account?
reference_answer: Open Add money, choose Bank transfer, copy the account details and send the money from your other bank using any reference shown.

input: How do I top up my account with a cash payment?
reference_answer: Open Add money, choose Cash, find a partner shop and show the deposit barcode. Each deposit is £5 to £500 with a 1.5% fee.

input: There's a Direct Debit payment in my account that I didn't make
reference_answer: Check the company name, cancel the Direct Debit under Payments, Direct Debits, and contact support so an agent can review it and raise a refund claim.

input: Fix my contactless
reference_answer: Make a chip and PIN payment first, check contactless is switched on, and check the card is activated and not frozen. If it fails everywhere, order a replacement.

input: Is my pending cash withdrawal processed?
reference_answer: Pending means the cash machine operator has not sent the final record yet. Most complete or disappear within 7 days.

input: I want to order a card. Where do you deliver to?
reference_answer: Physical cards can only be delivered to an address in a supported country: the UK or the European Economic Area.

input: why hasn't my top up gone through yet
reference_answer: The money is not confirmed yet. Card top-ups can take up to 1 hour, cash up to 1 working day, UK transfers up to 1 working day and international 3 to 5 working days. Do not repeat it; contact support if it takes longer.

input: I have a duplicate payment showing
reference_answer: If one entry is pending it normally disappears within 7 days. If both completed, ask the merchant for a refund, and if they will not help, report a problem or contact support.

input: How do I select a Mastercard instead of a Visa?
reference_answer: If both networks are available in your country you can choose when ordering. Changing later needs a replacement card costing £5.

input: I can't verify my ID.
reference_answer: Use clear, glare-free photos of a valid, accepted document with all corners visible, and a clear selfie video. If it takes more than 2 working days or keeps failing, contact support.

input: I made a mistake and need to cancel a transaction
reference_answer: While it shows Scheduled or Pending, open it and choose Cancel transfer. A completed transfer cannot be cancelled; ask the recipient to return it, or contact support about a recall.

input: Did my refund go through? It's not on my statement.
reference_answer: Refunds usually take 5 to 10 working days. A pending original payment may simply disappear. After 10 working days get proof from the merchant and send it to support.

input: What's the U.S. Delivery time?
reference_answer: Cards cannot be delivered to the US: physical cards are only delivered to the UK or European Economic Area.

input: Is it okay to use a bank card to top up
reference_answer: Yes. Visa and Mastercard debit and credit cards in your own name can be used; American Express and prepaid gift cards cannot.

input: How long will it take to activate my new card?
reference_answer: The card is active straight away after you open Cards, choose Activate and enter its last 4 digits.

input: Where do I order a virtual card from?
reference_answer: Open Cards, choose Add card, then Virtual card. It is free and ready immediately once identity verification is passed.

input: How do I get my salary through this account?
reference_answer: Give your employer the details shown under Account, Account details; salary arrives like any bank transfer.

input: I see a cash withdrawal that I did not perform.
reference_answer: Freeze the card, report it lost or stolen if you did not make the withdrawal, change your passcode and contact support, who must review it.

input: My account shows the card payment cancelled.
reference_answer: The payment was cancelled before completing, for example by the merchant or because it was not collected in time. The money returns to your balance; ask the merchant whether you need to pay again.

input: Is it possible to use my credit card to transfer money?
reference_answer: You can add money using a Visa or Mastercard credit card in your own name through Add money, Card. Credit card top-ups have a 1.5% fee.

input: My payments from my virtual card keep getting rejected.
reference_answer: Check the card is not frozen, online payments are switched on, the balance is enough and the details are current. Some merchants require a physical card. If a new virtual card also fails, contact support.

input: I went to top up and it is no longer there.  Was it sent back?
reference_answer: A reversed top-up is returned to where it came from. Causes include the card provider not settling it, failed security checks, a source not in your name or missing verification. The money usually arrives back in 5 to 10 working days.

input: Is there a charge for topping up by transfer?
reference_answer: NovaPay does not charge for UK or SEPA bank transfer top-ups; on SWIFT transfers banks may deduct their own charges.

input: I would like to not have to do the identity verification.
reference_answer: Verification cannot be skipped. It is legally required and needed before using the account fully.

input: I do not have my pin
reference_answer: The PIN is not posted. In Cards, select the physical card and choose View PIN, then enter your passcode.

input: I know I didn't make this payment showing up on my card, I don't remember this person at all.
reference_answer: Check the trading name, date and subscriptions. If it was not you, freeze the card, report it lost or stolen and contact support, who can open a dispute.

input: I need a refund on an item I have not received.  Am I able to simply cancel the payment?  I don't know how to do this.
reference_answer: Contact the merchant first. If they will not help, you may be able to dispute the payment, for example when goods did not arrive; keep your evidence.

input: Why could my transfer have been declined?
reference_answer: Reasons include not enough money, wrong recipient details, rejection by the receiving bank, security checks, unfinished identity or source of funds checks, or a recipient or destination that is not allowed. Check the reason in the app.

input: What is accepted in regards to cards and currencies?
reference_answer: Visa and Mastercard debit and credit cards in your own name; not American Express or prepaid gift cards. Held currencies are GBP, EUR, USD, CHF, PLN, SEK, NOK, DKK, AUD, CAD, JPY and NZD.

input: How much will I pay to exchange foreign currency?
reference_answer: On weekdays the first £1,000 a month has no NovaPay fee and amounts above it cost 0.5%. A 1% markup applies from Friday 22:00 to Sunday 22:00 UK time.

input: I don't have my access code for the app.
reference_answer: On the sign-in screen choose Forgot passcode, confirm your phone number with a one-time code, record a selfie video and set a new passcode.

input: My PIN is not working and I need assistance.
reference_answer: Check the correct number with View PIN. After 3 wrong attempts the PIN is blocked; use Unblock PIN under Cards. If it is still refused, contact support.

input: Can you tell me the limits for top ups?
reference_answer: By card: minimum £10, up to £5,000 per top-up, £10,000 per day and £30,000 in 30 days. Cash is £5 to £500 per deposit. Bank transfers have no NovaPay upper limit, though over £10,000 may need a source of funds check.

input: I think something went wrong with my card delivery as I haven't received it yet.
reference_answer: Check the estimated date in Cards. If it has passed, choose Report not delivered; the card is cancelled and a new one is sent free after an agent checks.

input: I need help with a lost card
reference_answer: Freeze the card immediately. If you cannot find it, report it lost or stolen, which blocks it permanently; a replacement costs £5. Contact support about payments you did not make.

input: I got a fee for an ATM withdrawal.
reference_answer: Up to £200 in up to 5 withdrawals a month is free of NovaPay fees; after that it is 2% with a £1 minimum. The machine operator may charge too.

input: Why could I not choose cash at the ATM?
reference_answer: Possible reasons include low balance, the £500 daily limit, wrong or blocked PIN, a frozen or inactive card, withdrawals switched off, security checks or a machine fault. Check the reason in the app.

input: The exchange rates are?
reference_answer: Rates are based on the interbank mid-market rate; the live rate is shown in Exchange. A 1% weekend markup applies.

input: Am I able to order a new card and have it sent to me in China?
reference_answer: No. Physical cards are only delivered to addresses in the UK or European Economic Area.

input: Is it necessary to verify my top up?
reference_answer: Verification shows you own the card used to top up and protects against fraud; most card top-ups ask you to approve them with your card provider.

input: When should I expect to see my transfer hit my account?
reference_answer: It depends on the type: NovaPay users immediately, UK usually within 2 hours and at most 1 working day, SEPA 1 working day, SWIFT 1 to 5 working days for transfers you send.

input: Do I need any kind of documentation for the identity check?
reference_answer: A valid passport, driving licence or national identity card in your name, plus a short selfie video.

input: I purchased an item and the exchange rate I was given was incorrect.
reference_answer: The NovaPay rate at authorisation applies unless the merchant converted it, which is often worse. Check the rate, fees and weekend markup; if it does not match, contact support with the receipt.

input: Someone transferred money to me and it doesn't show
reference_answer: Allow up to 1 working day for UK and SEPA and 3 to 5 for SWIFT, check the sender's details and the right currency balance, then contact support with proof of payment.

input: Can I get a card despite the fact I'm not in the UK?
reference_answer: Accounts are only available to people living in the UK or a European Economic Area country.

input: If I feel someone has my card information, can I get a new card?
reference_answer: Yes. Freeze the card, report it lost or stolen and contact support; a new card number is issued.

input: I thought transfers were free, why was I charged a fee?
reference_answer: UK, SEPA and NovaPay-to-NovaPay transfers are free; SWIFT costs £3 and other banks may deduct charges. Check the fee details on the transfer.

input: Could you help me reactivate my card? It was previously lost, but I found it this morning in my jacket.
reference_answer: A card you only froze can be unfrozen or linked again under Cards. A card reported lost or stolen is permanently blocked and cannot be used again.

input: can i top up with apple pay
reference_answer: No. You cannot add money through Apple Pay. Use a debit or credit card, a bank transfer or cash.

input: If I want to top up, can I use Apple Pay?
reference_answer: No. You cannot add money through Apple Pay. Use a debit or credit card, a bank transfer or cash.

input: How do I use a disposable virtual card?
reference_answer: Get one under Cards, Add card, Disposable card. Use it for one online payment; its number then changes.

input: What does a disposable virtual card do?
reference_answer: It is a virtual card for one online payment; after a completed payment the number stops working and a new one is made.

input: How many disposable cards can I make in a single day?
reference_answer: You can have 1 active disposable card, and its number can change up to 5 times in one day.

input: What can I use a virtual disposable card for?
reference_answer: One-off online payments. Not for subscriptions, deposits, card readers or cash machines.

input: How do I know which ATMs will accept this card?
reference_answer: Machines that show your card network's logo, Visa or Mastercard.

input: Are there certain ATMs that I can use this card at?
reference_answer: You can use machines that show your card network's logo, in the UK and abroad. NovaPay has none of its own.

input: What do I do if an ATM "stole" my card?
I was at an ATM and it swallowed my card.
reference_answer: Freeze the card. If you do not get it back, report it lost or stolen to block it and order a replacement.

input: Is there any way to Auto top-up?
Can I be topped up once I hit a certain balance?
If my phone is missing, can I block someone from using the app?
reference_answer: Contact support from another device; support can sign the account out of the lost phone and block access.

input: I lost my phone and would like to freeze my accounts.
reference_answer: Contact support from another device so they can sign the account out of the lost phone and block access. Lock or erase the phone.

input: got married, need to change account name
reference_answer: You cannot change your name yourself. Contact support with a document showing the change, such as a marriage certificate.

input: got married and need to change name
reference_answer: You cannot change your name yourself. Contact support with a document showing the change, such as a marriage certificate.

input: Please close my account. I am unsatisfied with your service.
reference_answer: Move your money out and cancel regular payments, then contact support, who must close the account.

input: I need your help in deleting my account.
reference_answer: Move your money out and cancel regular payments, then contact support, who must close the account.

input: How old do you have to be to get an account?
reference_answer: You must be at least 18.

input: I would like an account for my children, how do I go about doing this?
reference_answer: NovaPay does not offer accounts for children. You must be at least 18.

reference_answer: A contactless payment can be up to £100, with a PIN check after £300 in a row. Unblock the PIN under Cards with Unblock PIN.

input: How long does express delivery take and what does it cost?
reference_answer: UK express delivery takes 2 to 3 working days and costs £12.

input: When will my renewal card come and will I pay for it?
reference_answer: About 30 days before the old card expires, and renewal with standard delivery is free.

input: What's the minimum card top-up, and is there a fee if I use a UK debit card?
reference_answer: The minimum is £10 and UK debit card top-ups are free.

input: How much can I take from a cash machine each day and how much of it is free each month?
reference_answer: £500 per day; up to £200 in up to 5 withdrawals per month has no NovaPay fee.

input: Which documents prove my identity and how long does the check take?
reference_answer: A passport, driving licence or national identity card plus a selfie video; most checks take minutes, some up to 2 working days.

input: How long do SEPA transfers take and are they free?
reference_answer: 1 working day, and they are free.

input: Can I hold Swiss francs, and what does it cost to exchange into them on a Saturday?
reference_answer: Yes, CHF can be held. At weekends a 1% markup applies, plus 0.5% above the £1,000 monthly allowance.

input: I need to freeze my card and also stop a Direct Debit. How?
reference_answer: Freeze it under Cards. Cancel the Direct Debit under Payments, Direct Debits.

input: How do I make a virtual card, and how many can I have at once?
reference_answer: Cards, Add card, Virtual card; up to 3 active virtual cards.

input: How long do I have to dispute a payment and how long does a decision take?
reference_answer: Raise it within 120 days; most are decided within 15 working days and complex ones within 45.

input: What's the fee for paying in cash at a shop and how much can I deposit at once?
reference_answer: The fee is 1.5% and each deposit must be £5 to £500.

input: Can I cancel a pending transfer, and how long can one normally take to a UK bank?
reference_answer: Yes, open it and choose Cancel transfer. UK transfers usually arrive within 2 hours, at most 1 working day.

input: Do you support crypto, and which cards can't I use to top up?
reference_answer: Crypto is not supported. American Express and prepaid gift cards cannot be used.

input: When would you ask where my money comes from and how long is that review?
reference_answer: For example after large or unusual payments such as bank transfers over £10,000; reviews usually take up to 3 working days.

input: My refund hasn't arrived. How long should it take and what do I send you if it's late?
reference_answer: 5 to 10 working days; after that send the merchant's proof with date, amount and reference.

input: How do I activate a new card and when does contactless start working?
reference_answer: Cards, Activate, enter the last 4 digits. Contactless starts after a chip and PIN payment.

input: What does a SWIFT transfer cost and how long does it take to arrive?
reference_answer: £3, and 1 to 5 working days.

input: How do I reset a forgotten passcode, and would your staff ever ask me for it?
reference_answer: Choose Forgot passcode, confirm the code sent to your phone, record a selfie and set a new one. Staff never ask for it.

input: My card 4111 1111 1111 1111 got declined, why?
reference_answer: Open the payment to see the reason; common causes include low balance, wrong details, a frozen card, the daily limit or security checks.

reference_answer: Freeze it, and report it lost or stolen if you cannot find it.
